...economic environment
 In the Eastern Africa region, there is a mixed
bag of economic news:
 High Inflation in EA –at December 2011, Kenya inflation stood at
18.9%; Uganda’s at 27%, Tanzania at 19.8% while Rwanda was at
8.3%, Ethiopia 42%

 GDP growth rates in EA for 2011 –Kenya 4.5%; Uganda 5.2%;
Tanzania 7.1%; and Rwanda was 8.8%
 Projected GDP growth rates in EA for 2012 -Kenya 5.3%; Uganda
5.6%; Tanzania 7.5%; and Rwanda was 7.5%
 Emerging opportunities in South Sudan following independent status
in 2011
